import base from "../../playwright.config";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export default {
  ...base,
  testDir: "../../",
  outputDir: "./results",
  reporter: [
    ...(base.reporter as [string, unknown][]).map(([reporter, options]) => [
      reporter.startsWith(".") ? fileURLToPath(new URL(`../../${reporter}`, import.meta.url)) : reporter,
      options,
    ]),
    ["./predecessor-reporter.ts"],
  ],
  webServer: Array.isArray(base.webServer)
    ? base.webServer.map((server) => ({ ...server, cwd: fileURLToPath(new URL("../../", import.meta.url)) }))
    : base.webServer,
};
